title.en: Force between two parallel currents; the ampere
title.kn: ಎರಡು ಸಮಾಂತರ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಬಲ; ಆಂಪಿಯರ್

hook.en: Two wires carrying current in the same direction pull towards each other. This small force is so reliable that for decades it was used to define the ampere.
hook.kn: ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ತಂತಿಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಲ ಎಷ್ಟು ನಿಖರವೆಂದರೆ ದಶಕಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಆಂಪಿಯರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಇದರಿಂದಲೇ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.

objectives.en: Find the force per unit length between parallel currents.

narration.en: Two wires carrying current in the same direction pull towards each other. This small force is so reliable that for decades it was used to define the ampere.
narration.kn: ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹವಿರುವ ಎರಡು ತಂತಿಗಳು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಈ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಲ ಎಷ್ಟು ನಿಖರವೆಂದರೆ ದಶಕಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಆಂಪಿಯರ್ ಅನ್ನು ಇದರಿಂದಲೇ ವ್ಯಾಖ್ಯಾನಿಸಲಾಗಿತ್ತು.

body.en: Wire a, carrying $I_a$, produces $B = \mu_0I_a/2\pi d$ at wire b, a distance d away. Wire b, carrying $I_b$, therefore feels a force per unit length $f = \mu_0I_aI_b/2\pi d$. Currents in the same direction attract; currents in opposite directions repel. This is the reverse of electric charges, where like charges repel.
body.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂತಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ಕಾಂತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಬಲ f = μ₀I_aI_b/2πd. ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನವು ವಿಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

narration.en: Each wire sits in the other's magnetic field, so the force per metre is mu nought I a I b by 2 pi d. Parallel currents attract and antiparallel currents repel.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂತಿ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ಕಾಂತಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಬಲ f = μ₀I_aI_b/2πd. ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳು ಆಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ, ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನವು ವಿಕರ್ಷಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: On the board: force between parallel currents

narration.en: Two long parallel wires, a distance d apart, carry currents I_a and I_b in the same direction. Wire a makes a field μ₀I_a/2πd at wire b, pointing into the page there. So wire b feels a force I_b L B_a towards wire a: parallel currents attract, opposite currents repel. The ampere: 1 A in each of two wires 1 m apart in vacuum gives a force of 2 × 10⁻⁷ newton per metre. Example: 10 A and 5 A, 4 cm apart, give f = 2 × 10⁻⁷ × 50 / 0.04 = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ newton per metre.

say.en: Two long parallel wires, a distance d apart, carry currents I_a and I_b in the same direction.
Wire a makes a field μ₀I_a/2πd at wire b, pointing into the page there.
So wire b feels a force I_b L B_a towards wire a: parallel currents attract, opposite currents repel.
The ampere: 1 A in each of two wires 1 m apart in vacuum gives a force of 2 × 10⁻⁷ newton per metre.
Example: 10 A and 5 A, 4 cm apart, give f = 2 × 10⁻⁷ × 50 / 0.04 = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ newton per metre.

body.en: One ampere is that steady current which, flowing in two very long, straight, parallel conductors of negligible cross-section placed 1 m apart in vacuum, produces between them a force of 2 × 10⁻⁷ N per metre of length. The coulomb then follows: 1 C = 1 A × 1 s.
body.kn: ನಿರ್ವಾತದಲ್ಲಿ 1 m ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಎರಡು ಉದ್ದ ಸಮಾಂತರ ತಂತಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ 2 × 10⁻⁷ N ಬಲ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುವ ಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರವಾಹವೇ ಒಂದು ಆಂಪಿಯರ್.

points.en: 1 A: 2 × 10⁻⁷ N m⁻¹ at 1 m separation

narration.en: One ampere is the current that, in two long parallel wires one metre apart in vacuum, produces a force of two times ten to the minus seven newton per metre.

tryThis.en: Set 10 A, 5 A and 4 cm: f = 0.25 mN/m = 2.5 × 10⁻⁴ N/m, as on the board.
Reverse I_b: the force changes sign, so the wires repel.
Halve d: the force doubles (it goes as 1/d, not 1/d²).

heading.en: Opposite rules for currents and charges

body.en: Like charges repel, but like (parallel) currents attract. Unlike charges attract, but unlike (antiparallel) currents repel.

narration.en: Opposite rules for currents and charges. Like charges repel, but like (parallel) currents attract. Unlike charges attract, but unlike (antiparallel) currents repel.

mnemonic.en: Charges: like repel. Currents: like attract.
